cursed_hermit.name: Cursed Hermit
cursed_hermit.lore: A wanderer who ventured too deep into the Cursed Forest and emerged... changed.
cursed_hermit.text: A wild-eyed hermit blocks the path, muttering about shadows.

result.text: The hermit trades a strange trinket for your supplies.
The hermit shuffles aside, muttering curses under their breath.
